title: Reception of the Paging message by the UE

entities.name: Paging message
entities.description: Message received by UE containing paging records and group lists for paging procedures.

entities.name: PagingRecord
entities.description: Contains ue-Identity for matching against UE identities during paging.

entities.name: ue-Identity
entities.description: Identity field in PagingRecord used for matching against UE's stored identities.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs paging record matching against upper layer allocated identities.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE performs paging record matching against stored fullI-RNTI and may initiate connection resumption.

entities.name: RRC connection resumption procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE in RRC_INACTIVE state when paging matches certain conditions.

entities.name: Access Identity 1
entities.description: UE configuration condition that triggers RRC connection resumption with mps-PriorityAccess.

entities.name: Access Identity 2
entities.description: UE configuration condition that triggers RRC connection resumption with mcs-PriorityAccess.

entities.name: Access Identities 11-15
entities.description: UE configuration condition that triggers RRC connection resumption with highPriorityAccess.

entities.name: pagingGroupList
entities.description: Contains TMGI values for MBS session paging.

entities.name: TMGI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Group Identity used for MBS session identification in paging.

entities.name: L2 U2N Relay UE
entities.description: Condition where UE acts as relay and processes paging records for remote UEs.

entities.name: Uu Message transfer in sidelink
entities.description: Procedure initiated by L2 U2N Relay UE when paging matches remote UE identity.

relations.description: Paging message contains one or more PagingRecord information elements.
Paging message may contain pagingGroupList with TMGI values.
PagingRecord contains ue-Identity field for identity matching.
RRC connection resumption procedure requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state.
Access Identity 1 configuration guards the initiation of RRC connection resumption with mps-PriorityAccess.
Access Identity 2 configuration guards the initiation of RRC connection resumption with mcs-PriorityAccess.
Access Identities 11-15 configuration guards the initiation of RRC connection resumption with highPriorityAccess.
pagingGroupList contains TMGI values for MBS session identification.
L2 U2N Relay UE condition guards the initiation of Uu Message transfer in sidelink procedure.
